g.text: Build, change or run an AI step
Simple request that fits a template?
Device model allowed for this task and
Cloud allowed, online and set up?
App Check token on every call.
Code builds the KalamSpec from the matched template.
Gemini Nano may fill missing parameters on this device
within a short budget; the template defaults are the
kalamSpecialistReason Cloud Function: Claude plans and
repairs, Nebius reads sketches. Needs external-provider
consent and a stated reason. No cascade to Firebase.
Asked through the Firebase AI Logic hybrid SDK: Gemini
Nano (web, Android) or Apple Foundation Models (iOS), text
only. Classify, summarize, translate, voice, patch,
extract. only_on_device is never widened to cloud.
Plain message, input kept, nothing sent. Offline, consent
off, or Firebase not set up.
• one-time cloud notice before the first call
• client rate limit: token bucket per task
• result cache: 500 entries, 24 h, safe tasks only
• retries: 2 on 429, 5xx or network, 1 on timeout
• at most ONE cloud fallback after a device failure
Hybrid AI routing: deterministic first, device next, cloud when justified
Source: src/core/ai/routing.ts (planRoute, TASK_POLICIES), orchestrator.ts, pipeline/create-application.ts, docs/07 §9
